_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Mechanical Worst Case Analysis Report of Dimensions and Tolerances
summary: This DID establishes the format and content preparation instructions for a report documenting a mechanical worst case tolerance analysis performed on parts, subassemblies, assemblies and equipment.
use_relationship:
This report documents a mechanical worst case tolerance analysis performed on parts, subassemblies, assemblies and equipment.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task equipment for this data included in the contract.
The documentation required by this DID is used to support the configuration end item product interchangeability requirements in the contract.
This DID is applicable whenever a contract requires mechanical designs with tolerance features.
This DID supersedes DI-QCIC-80890.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format:
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in contractor's format and shall be no larger than 8 1/2 by 11".

preparation_instructions.title: Content:
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Title page.
children.content: The first page of the report shall be a title page and shall contain the following about the applicable part, subassembly, assembly or equipment analyzed:

children.title: Table of contents.
children.content: The second page of the report shall be a table of contents.

children.title: Body of report.
children.content: The body of the report shall include the following:

children.title: Summary.
children.content: A summary of the analysis, highlighting the potential problem areas.

children.title: Introduction.
children.content: Introduction information shall include the following:

children.title: Description of each analysis performed, or reference to the appropriate Government document
Identification of the applicable parts, subassemblies, assemblies of equipment analyzed.
Data base.
children.content: The data base shall include the following:

children.title: A list of all drawings/part list
Justification for the use of any tolerances
Analysis.
children.content: Analysis information shall contain the following:

children.title: Statement identifying the parts, subassembly, assembly of equipment being analyzed.
Verification that a worst case tolerance analysis allows no excessive interferences, clearances, or excursions to exist that would cause failure.
Verification that the part, subassembly, assembly or equipment performs properly under all applicable environmental conditions.
A tolerance distribution for economical processing of the part, subassembly, assembly or equipment.
Applicable areas of engineering drawings or sketches to assist in the understanding of the analysis
All calculations relevant to the analysis
Any problems of potential problems with the part, subassembly, assembly or equipment.
Conclusion.
children.content: The conclusion shall contain the following:

children.title: A summary of the analysis results.
Recommendations to correct any problems or potential problems noted during the analysis.
